freeze_package_rule: Every exact closed package file including its envelope is present as package/NAME in files, with bytes/SHA256 pins; package verifier and package PDF paths must be present. Outer ZIP is exactly the closed package without a wrapper directory. PDF alias equals package/paper/note.pdf.
freeze_future_helpers: All six helper basenames to bytes/SHA256 pins matching complete seven-source operations inventory; original repository Zenodo kit is seventh dependency.
freeze_evidence_privacy: source_record_private.txt is authenticated only as private external evidence. Never include raw source record or SQLite/cache in public package/allowlist/archive.
review_external_spec: NN:MANIFEST_SHA256, consecutive01..NN including every adverse or unfinished round
review_manifest_rule: files map bytes/SHA256; explicit_public_allowlist exact same names; manifest omits itself; additional public evidence permitted only explicitly listed and pinned.

acceptance_rule: At least TWO consecutive latest clean ENTIRE reviews of same CURRENT freeze, distinct fresh agents, after every fix. Both have no required/optional issues and no theorem gap. Historical candidates need D/reviewed_candidates/candidateNN/FREEZE.json + old OPERATIONS_INVENTORY.json + operations/REPO_RELATIVE_SOURCE copies and all frozen files.
conditional_inherited_obligation: PF01-R04 can verify that the gate implements the two-new-review obligation; frozen package does not claim the future review obligation was already complete. Actual acceptance requires both independently sealed clean rounds.
authentication_original_record: Each of all24 exact original repo paths: bytes,sha256,git_blob,git_mode:100644,disk_mode:0644,archive_mode:100644,disk_and_archive_match:true. Authentication timestamps lie inside review interval, enclosing COLD timestamp.
cold_mode_rule: Four rows normal/O/OO/env2 observed_outer_optimization0/1/2/0, integer returncode0, receipt exact canonical D/PACKAGE_REPLAY_LABEL.json[receipt], no normalization or ignored fields. Root envelopes with timestamps/absolute commands are frozen separately.
native_accounting: Dynamic current target state/history must be absent or exact already-published recovery state; otherwise reconcile. Publication audit event imports turns_used4 solely from immutable PR declaration, explicit unauthenticated basis, historical countUNKNOWN, no candidate_turn or historical proof events, zero added proof responses. Preserve unrelated queue/state/history bytes.
mergeability: Fresh MERGEABLE required before ready/merge; UNKNOWN or conflicting is a blocker, never permission to integrate/rebase.
stage_publish: Unchanged repository kit real check precedes separate stage and publish. Persistent intent prevents blind repeat. Inspect probes exact existing ID; one publish POST maximum. Only exact Python>=3.11 -> Python>=3.11 notes storage exception, if actual reviewed preimage exists.
publication_verification: Independent unauthenticated public record GET, exact PDF/archive downloads SHA256/size/file-set, and DOI resolution to same exact record required.
